static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.educational_background: 成长过程中参加过烹饪课程
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友和家人的关系因负面自我评价而紧张；虽有少数可交谈的亲友，但难以分享Self-doubt与失败恐惧
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前not yet就这些症状寻求治疗或咨询；在遭遇拒绝或挫折（尤其与烹饪相关）时长期体验失败感与Self-doubt
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe emotions and events; tone neutral but with a sense of frustration; relatively high cooperation; when talking about negative feelings tends toward restraint and self-closure

basic_info.main_problem: 近期not yet通过一次试镜后，我在失败感与Self-doubt中挣扎，这些感受自童年延续，近几个月加剧。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望找到方法打破Self-doubt和对失败的恐惧的循环，改善动力与心理健康。
growth_experiences: 童年时期在烹饪课程中，当事情not按计划进行时就出现强烈的失败感与Self-doubt，这一模式延续至今。
成年后在与烹饪相关的试镜或新项目中遭遇拒绝或挫折时，类似的负性体验反复出现；not yet曾寻求治疗，逐渐内化为“I will fail”的Anticipation。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次试镜失败，就说明I will never succeed、I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shuts himself down, reduces attempts, and avoids new auditions to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我每次都会失败/我永远not够好

special_situations.event: 在新的烹饪项目中出现差错或not按计划进行
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果项目出现问题，就证明我not具备能力，后续只会更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pauses projects, reduces innovation and challenges, avoids possible mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次失败预示着一切都会变糟

special_situations.event: 遭遇拒绝或收到负面反馈（如试镜not yet通过）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Being rejected，就说明I am a failure，我的所有尝试都会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers goals, refuses new opportunities, avoids risk

special_situations.event: 与朋友或家人互动时想到要分享Self-doubt与失败感
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表达这些感受，do not人会认为我软弱并看轻我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing and in-depth communication, keeping a surface normality to reduce negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 说出来只会让关系更糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen, to prove her own value and ability
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与Being rejected，被视为软弱或not够好
defense_goal: 通过保持自我关闭与回避挑战来减少羞耻与被negate的可能
Avoids exposing vulnerability to others to maintain a sense of security

object_relations.object_representation: Critical others who may reject and belittle (reviewers, relatives and friends)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请或期待在咨询中深入分享Self-doubt与失败感时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将暴露脆弱理解为会被看轻或negate，因而倾向避免表达（移情：担心被评价为软弱）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone steady but restrained, reduces emotion vocabulary, downplays negative experiences, avoids staying on emotional details for long

manifestations: 长期的Self-doubt与失败感导致Decreased motivation，难以维持与烹饪相关的日常活动
Although there are family and friends to talk to, worries about appearing weak and avoids sharing troubles

contact_model.definition: 个体克制本应向外表达或寻求他人帮助的冲动，将能量Turning against the self（与“冲动”对应）。
manifestations: After a setback, 'shuts down', stopping action and communication
本可寻求支持却选择独自承受

contact_model.definition: not良的自我Reflection包含过多的自我限制与苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎（与“自主性”对应）。
manifestations: 担心表达会显得软弱或像在抱怨
Over-scrutinizes own words and actions, cautious to the point of affecting genuine contact

positive_force: Has some cooking training and practical experience (took cooking courses while growing up)
Willing to seek help and accept counseling, willing to try behavioral experiments
拥有少量可交谈的亲友支持网络
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括、预测not yet来、心理过滤等负性认知模式
Highly sensitive to rejection and setbacks, easily shuts down when encountering frustration
回避挑战与表达脆弱，依赖回避来降低Anxiety
自我评价低，常以“I am not good enough”定义自我

target_behavior.behavior: After encountering failure or rejection, 'self-shutdown' appears and one avoids new attempts
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化解释与“I am not good enough/我会一直失败”的过度概括信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避再次失败与羞耻，暂时降低Anxiety与压力
target_behavior.consequence: Motivation drops markedly, affecting auditions and new project performance; daily cooking activities blocked

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与亲友分享Self-doubt与失败感
antecedent: 与朋友或家人互动被询问近况
需要谈论失败经历或情绪时
target_behavior.core_reason: 预测他人会负面评价自己、认为表达脆弱等于软弱（预测not yet来、心理过滤）
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being looked down on and relationship deterioration, maintaining a surface sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、获得支持减少，Increased sense of isolation
